title: Waste of money
text:
I love the idea of getting an assortment of beauty items. 1 box was worth $25 to me, but for whatever reason all the other months sucked.

I did not receive one item that I thought I would ever purchase on my own. I felt like I was buying items that don’t sell well enough on their own.

I had it for over 6 months. I kept telling myself I would cancel if the next box wasn’t good. I waited 6 months too long to cancel.
label: negative
